analytic_derivation.degenerate_fibre: R = 1 <=> s = 1/2 <=> c*(t-1) = 0, i.e. exactly {Xi = 0, any c} union {c = 0, any Xi}

injectivity_empirical.note: Every nondegenerate grid point maps to a DISTINCT (R, s). This is the empirical companion to the algebraic argument, not a substitute for it.

arm_c_minimum_observable.exact_identity: s - 1/2 = -(R - 1) / (2 R c) holds identically along any fixed-R family, so s determines c given R, and (c, Xi) follows.
arm_c_minimum_observable.note: A continuum of distinct (c, Xi) states -- of BOTH signs of c -- reproduces one R exactly. None of them reproduces the observed s. The extra measurement is demonstrated necessary from the observables, NOT asserted from the model having an internal state.

arm_d_proxy_adversary.comparator: analysis.lateral_proxy.frozen_two_path_proxy via analysis.lateral_coupling_discrimination.physical_row (CALLED, not reimplemented). It is the frozen UNCOUPLED share-proxy completion, NOT the complete dynamic streamtube model.
arm_d_proxy_adversary.why: For the mirror the uncoupled proxy share s0 is exactly 0.5, so s_proxy(alpha) = 0.5 for EVERY alpha; and the frozen completion holds Q/Q0 = 1 while physical coupling raises it. The proxy misses BOTH observables at once, structurally.

numerical_conditioning_of_the_existing_m.finding: The exact-network solve loses ~log10(G_lat/A) significant digits to cancellation in det = a*d - G_lat^2 as G_lat grows. It is a floating-point conditioning limit of models.lateral_coupling.model1_two_path, NOT a physical defect, NOT a model error, and it is not a defect that invalidates this screen's inference.

arm_f_mirror_imperfection.alternative_explanation: The inverse is an artifact of exact mirror symmetry and will return a misleading Xi when a real apparatus is only approximately mirrored.
arm_f_mirror_imperfection.perturbation_design: Deterministic 16 sign corners of (a,b,b,a)*(1 +/- delta) at each level. NOT a random sample.

blocked_bridge_outlet_share.observation: With the bridge BLOCKED the two outlet flows are separately measurable, and s0 = q1_blocked/Q0 is exactly 0.5 for a true mirror. Every perturbed corner at every level departs from 0.5, so this is a direct pre-test of the symmetry the ideal inverse assumes -- taken with the SAME fixture, before any coupled run.
blocked_bridge_outlet_share.on_this_corner_set: At every level the 4 of 16 sign corners that remain EXACT mirrors (g1_top = g2_bot, g1_bot = g2_top) are precisely the 4 with zero blocked-share departure AND zero Xi bias; all 12 that break the mirror show both. On this corner set the test is exact -- but see the counting diagnostic below, which exhibits a whole family it cannot see.

post_hoc_diagnostics.label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_IN_DECISION

unconstrained_geometry_non_identifiabili.and_the_blocked_share_test_does_not_catc: Every member holds the two end-to-end SERIES conductances equal, so the blocked-bridge outlet share is exactly 0.5 for all of them. The blocked share tests lane BALANCE, not the top/bottom SPLIT arrangement, which no blocked measurement can see. So the blocked-run share is a NECESSARY but NOT SUFFICIENT check on the mirror assumption: the split must be controlled by construction (layer depths and materials built to the same nominal values), not verified after the fact from boundary flows.
unconstrained_geometry_non_identifiabili.conclusion: A one-parameter family of DIFFERENT geometries, each with a different Xi, reproduces all four boundary flows exactly. Boundary flows alone therefore do NOT identify Xi for an arbitrary two-lane apparatus. The mirror CONSTRUCTION is what closes the system -- and it is a design assumption about the fixture, not a measurement of k_lat or w.
unconstrained_geometry_non_identifiabili.label: POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC_NOT_IN_DECISION

post_hoc_diagnostics.why_reported: Neither of these feeds any clause of the frozen decision rule, and neither was used to select a threshold. They are reported because the decisive-experiment specification would be misleading without them: they bound WHERE the licensed claim applies.

three_things_distinguished.bias_from_assuming_unverified_symmetry: This arm — the ideal mirror inverse applied to a geometry that is not one.
three_things_distinguished.recoverability_with_calibrated_axial_seg: invert_G_from_known_axials — exact for ANY geometry, no symmetry assumed.
three_things_distinguished.structural_identifiability_of_the_ideal_: Arm B — exact in the designed geometry.

claim_ceiling: A cheap scientific screen, human-selected and post-snapshot. It is SYNTHETIC / MATHEMATICAL identifiability in the exact steady two-path Darcy network under a controlled mirror geometry -- NOT empirical validation of anything. It promotes no evidence rung. It produces NO real-puck Xi estimate and no k_lat estimate. It makes no claim that espresso occupies the transition regime or any regime. The 1/2/5 % figures are hypothetical resolution scenarios reusing the existing floor convention; they are not instrument accuracies, not experimental uncertainty, and no apparatus is shown able to attain the required precision. Paper 4 is NOT authorized.

decision_record.arm: all seven frozen clauses evaluate true

clauses.evidence: max |analytic - network| = 7.99361e-15 (tol 1e-12); recovery passes at all 220 nondegenerate grid points
clauses.text: the mirror forward map and inverse are algebraically valid

clauses.evidence: algebraic: the inverse is a single-valued function of (R, s) built from divisions by (1-c), (1+c), c, R, all nonzero on the domain. empirical: min pairwise (R,s) distance = 5.11676e-06 over 220 points
clauses.text: the map (signed c, Xi) -> (R, s) is one-to-one over the nondegenerate domain
numerical recovery passes over the predeclared grid

clauses.evidence: swap: R preserved, share departure reverses, c_hat reverses, Xi_hat unchanged. scale: flows x10, R/s/c_hat/Xi_hat invariant
clauses.text: path swap and scale controls recover the same Xi

clauses.evidence: both return status degenerate_no_information with Xi_hat = None; nothing is regularised, clipped or epsilon-shifted
clauses.text: the identical-path and Xi=0 cases correctly report no information

clauses.evidence: a 24-member family of distinct (c, Xi), both signs of c, reproduces each observed R exactly; none reproduces the observed s; s - 1/2 = -(R-1)/(2Rc) is strictly monotone on each branch and sign-separated across them
clauses.text: Q-only inference is confounded while Q plus outlet share removes the confounding

clauses.evidence: s0 = 0.5 makes the proxy share alpha-invariant while the frozen completion holds Q/Q0 = 1; both observables are missed at once
clauses.text: no continuous-alpha proxy reproduces the joint physical signature in the primary mirror case

decision_record.licensed_claim: In the exact two-path mirror design, effective lateral coupling Xi is structurally identifiable from blocked/open total-flow measurements and separate outlet-flow share. Separate k_lat and w measurements are not mathematically necessary to infer Xi, although they remain necessary to decompose or physically interpret the effective conductance.

Xi_small_nonzero.classification: the exact inverse exists but both signals vanish linearly in Xi, so the measurement requirement diverges as 1/Xi

Xi_to_infinity.classification: structural identifiability persists (the inverse stays single-valued) while dR/dlnXi and ds/dlnXi -> 0, so practical sensitivity deteriorates

Xi_zero.classification: no coupling signature; inverse observationally degenerate for every c

c_zero.classification: identical paths; no mid-node pressure difference drives lateral flow, so Xi is unidentifiable

geometry.Xi_definition: Xi = 2*G_lat/A for the mirror (A1 = A2 = A)

identity_note: Human-selected from docs/cards/lateral_coupling_feasibility.md after the generated candidate snapshot. No I- number is minted; docs/insights/ID_REGISTRY.json and docs/insights/generated/ are untouched, and the 90 candidates were not scored, ranked or inspected.
model_domain: puckworks.models.lateral_coupling.model1_two_path — exact steady two-path Darcy network, P_out = 0 gauge, canonical q_lat_1to2 = G_lat*(p1-p2).
primary_quantity: Xi = G_lat*(1/A1 + 1/A2), the EXACT pressure-equalization number. The legacy provisional Lambda regime labels are not used.
question: In the controlled isoresistive-mirror two-path geometry, is the mapping from physical lateral coupling to (Q/Q0, outlet share s1) one-to-one, so that Xi can be recovered without separately measuring k_lat and w?

sensitivity_envelopes.scenario_definition: Each independently measured flow (q1, q2, Q0) carries a relative floor f. The perturbation set is the deterministic 3-level full factorial {-f, 0, +f}^3 (27 points, containing the 8 sign corners and the unperturbed point).

software_tolerances.note: Reproducibility bounds on exact floating-point arithmetic. They are NOT scientific uncertainties and were not retuned after seeing output. Recorded floats are rounded to 12 dp, so residuals below ~5e-13 record as 0.0.
